title: Classroom seating plan
goal: A reader can locate all 28 student desks, the teaching wall and storage, and trace a clear route from the entrance to every seat.

rubric.must: Exactly 28 student desk-and-chair units are arranged in four rows facing the whiteboard wall.
A labeled whiteboard and a separate teacher desk with a chair occupy the front teaching area.
Labeled storage has open floor space directly in front of it.
An unobstructed central aisle connects the entrance to every row, with visible walking gaps between rows and access to every desk.
The entrance shows a door leaf and swing arc with no furniture in the swept area.
Every desk and chair lies inside the room, with visible gaps separating it from walls and other furniture.
The room has visible windows, exterior dimensions of 12 m by 11 m, and a labeled 1.6 m central aisle.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the floorplan exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The drawing visibly satisfies the classroom program: 28 student desk-and-chair units appear as four rows of seven facing the north teaching wall; the whiteboard, teacher desk and chair, storage, entrance, windows, dimensions and central aisle are all shown with clear circulation and separation.

items.evidence: Exactly 28 desk-and-chair units are visible in four rows, with three units left and four right of the central aisle in each row; all face the whiteboard wall.
A labeled WHITEBOARD is on the front wall, with a separate labeled Teacher desk and chair in the open teaching area.
Labeled STORAGE is shown at the front-right wall with unobstructed open floor directly in front.
The entrance opens into a continuous central aisle, and visible lateral and inter-row gaps provide access to every row and desk.
The south entrance visibly includes a door leaf and swing arc, and no furniture occupies the swept area.
All desks and chairs are inside the room and visibly separated from walls, neighboring units and other furniture.
Windows are visible on both east and west walls, exterior dimensions are labeled 12.00 m by 11.00 m, and the central aisle is labeled 1.6 m; the north arrow establishes orientation.
